description: Add a new CRM contact, or edit one by contact_id — only the fields given change, and an empty string clears a field. tags REPLACES the contact's tags (use crm_tag_contacts to add or remove some). A new contact whose email or phone is already in the CRM is refused with that contact's id.

contact_id.description: Leave out to add a new contact.

name: crm_save_contact
title: Add or edit a contact
